dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Island Government Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm: Enhanced Forest Inventory 2020 - derived forest metrics based on LiDAR flown Summer of 2020 and continuous forest inventory measurements from ground plots collected summers 2020 and 2021. Attributes are: Top Height (topht), Large Dominant/Co-dominant Height (domht), Base to Live Crown (blc), Basal Area (ba), Merchantable Basal Area (bamerch), Quadratic Mean Diameter (qmd), Merchantable QMD (qmdmerch), Largest Tree Diameter (maxdbh), Merchantable Trees/ha (tphmerch), Gross Total Volume (gtv), GTV Volume to Basal Area Ratio (vbar).
